newsitem.title: USA: US stocks mostly lower at opening ahead of FOMC.
newsitem.headline: US stocks mostly lower at opening ahead of FOMC.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were mostly lower at the opening on Tuesday ahead the meeting of the Fed's interest rate panel.
Nervous investors were unlikely to take any strong positions until the Federal Reserve's Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) emerges from its meeting today with an announcement, analysts said.
Dow industrials were off 7 points at 5888. The NASDAQ Index was off 1 to 1214.
